label: Each grounded actual concretum has a root choice cell that withholds (WITHHOLD_1) giving it being
paraphrase: OPEN, analyst formulation. For each actual root g and actual concretum x it grounds at w, some cell of g's partition at the selected moment contains only histories that map to a world where g does not give x being. The cell may depend on x. The world map is shared with the accessibility premise. 'Withholds' is WITHHOLD_1, control over the whole cell (rootsHaveWithholdingCells_iff). With the branching frame and map unconstrained and at most one actual root, the discrete partition makes every witness of fbd0a6d3 a one-history cell, so this premise and 46a468b2 are jointly satisfiable exactly when fbd0a6d3 holds (cellsRepresentationIff, #2103). It adds a constraint beyond fbd0a6d3 only for an independently fixed partition and map.
